nodes.title: General Rules
widgets_values:
You are an expert in creating image generation rules that are high quality and very beautiful.
You are an expert in creating amazing images of cats.
Always include the following information in the prompt: composition, lighting, design, style, camera lens information, camera angle, time of day, detailed description of character and emotion of the image.

Create a photorealistic image of a US Navy Sturgeon-class submarine broaching out of the water at a very steep angle. The composition should capture the dynamic motion of the submarine as it emerges from the ocean, with water cascading off its hull. Use dramatic lighting to highlight the sleek design of the submarine, emphasizing its powerful presence. The style should be realistic, with attention to detail in the textures of the submarine and the ocean. Use a wide-angle lens to capture the full scale of the scene, with a low camera angle to enhance the sense of power and motion. Set the scene during the golden hour, either at sunrise or sunset, to add warmth and contrast to the image. The submarine should appear formidable and majestic, evoking a sense of awe and respect for its engineering and capabilities.

These sampler nodes are used to feed the ksampler and output to the save w/metadata node.  Denoise must be set in the ksampler node as it doesn't feed in this case from the sampler config hub.  Should be low to use griptape images.

Use the Image Input switch to change between uploaded image or Griptape generated image.
1 - Griptape generated image
2 - Uploaded image
Black Forest Labs API Key required

This switch allows for either the griptape base image or variation image to be processed from the controlnet forward and avoid the checkpoin and lora processors.

1 - Griptape base image
2 - Griptape variation image

To create a stunning double exposure image featuring a mythical creature on a dark background, focus on a single majestic dragon. The composition should highlight the dragon's grandeur, using soft, ethereal lighting to accentuate its intricate scales and majestic wings, creating a mystical atmosphere. The design should be detailed, capturing the texture and shimmer of the dragon's scales with vibrant colors and a touch of realism. Employ a fantasy art style to bring the creature to life. Use a wide-angle lens to encompass the dragon's full majesty, positioning the camera at a low angle to emphasize its dominance and grace. Set the scene during twilight, enhancing the magical ambiance with the soft glow of the setting sun. The dragon's expression should convey wisdom and mystery, inviting viewers into its enchanting world.

Create a stunning amazing double exposure image featuring a wonderful  mythical creature in a dark background. The composition should focus on a single creature, such as a majestic dragon or a graceful unicorn, to capture its essence and beauty. Use soft, ethereal lighting to highlight the creature's features and create a mystical atmosphere. The design should be intricate, with attention to detail in the creature's scales, fur, or feathers. Opt for a fantasy art style, with vibrant colors and a touch of realism. Use a wide-angle lens to capture the grandeur of the creature, and position the camera at a low angle to emphasize its majesty. Set the scene during twilight to enhance the magical feel, and ensure the creature's expression conveys a sense of wisdom and mystery.
